name: Coolant temperature sensor - open circuit
description: An unplugged NTC sensor reads -40 degC because the ECU pull-up drives the input to 5 V. The ECM stores P0118, substitutes a default temperature and lights the MIL. Diagnosed with the legislated OBD-II services.

steps.note: Waiting for the cluster bulb check to finish
Sensor voltage read with UDS: 0x1388 = 5000 mV, the pull-up level
The ECM sends its substitute value, not -40 degC
OBD Mode 03, functional request to 0x7DF: ECM and TCM both answer
Mode 02: the DTC that stored the freeze frame
Mode 09: the VIN needs a multi-frame ISO-TP response
Repair: plug the sensor back in
The MIL stays on: it needs three fault-free trips or a scan tool to go out
Mode 04: clear emission related diagnostic information
